previous_review.scope: v1 findings and retained compatibility/format/parity limits; not overwritten or rebound

v2_against_v1_changes_only: Add --no-ahead-behind to the existing porcelain-v2 branch status command.
Require final NUL and exclude only the final empty split element.

disposition: All three v1 minimal recommendations addressed; no additional concrete static defect identified in the stated framing and required-header scope. Ready for real-fixture parity validation, not release qualification.
integrity_review: Final NUL check rejects truncated framing before parsing; an empty body or interior empty entry raises GitError.
Raw rename original remains consumed independently and allowed to contain header/entry-looking text; nonempty path validation remains.
Duplicate branch headers fail even if the first value was empty because None, rather than truthiness, is the seen-state sentinel.
Unknown headers remain ignored; missing/empty required known values fail final checks.
Unborn (initial) still rejects; detached sentinel maps to None; 40/64 lowercase hex HEAD support preserved.
No-ahead-behind suppresses unused upstream count computation without dropping required branch/HEAD information.
Bounded space splits and surrogateescape unchanged; full raw filename path information retained.
limits: No full XY/submodule/mode/OID/rename-score grammar validation is claimed or requested. Ignored metadata is not newly used as application authority.
root and _execute remain virtual dispatch seams; status no longer calls overridden resolve_commit. No repository subclass depending on that dispatch was found in v1 review.
This change reduces status subprocess count from four to two for LocalGitService only; no measured latency improvement or browser cure is established.
Separate external Git/filesystem mutations remain best-effort observation, not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
Proposal is still private/unapplied at review time; source-bound final qualification must follow any application.
required_validation: Real ordinary/mixed state, rename, conflict and detached fixtures, compared exactly with preserved v1 GitStatus.
Actual upstream tracking and dirty submodule path parity; actual copy record if Git fixture/config can produce one, with synthetic copy record coverage regardless.
Unborn HEAD, nested/file input, worktree and independent root boundaries; injected root/_execute denial and environment checks.
Raw unusual and non-UTF8 filenames, rename original marker-looking names, unknown headers.
Malformed/truncated/empty framing, duplicate/missing required known headers, invalid HEAD, missing fields and empty/missing rename original.
Assert two expected subprocesses and preserve all original browser assertion deadlines.
